channel.title: The Grant Desk - Writers, US, added in last 30 days, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Writers, US, added in last 30 days, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 2 new grants - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:

    News Creator Corps (a project of the Good Information Foundation) · deadline Closed 17 Aug 2026 · $5,000 stipend on completing the programme. No application fee.
